title: Delete CreateBotPanel and TaskList, superseded by inline implementations
description:
**Found 2026-09-16 by the orphan survey on `77c09b`.**

Two components are imported by nothing because inline implementations replaced them and nobody deleted the originals:

- `web/components/CreateBotPanel.tsx` — `EnabledWorkspace` creates bots inline (`createBot` used 6 times there).
- `web/components/TaskList.tsx` — `EnabledWorkspace` renders tasks inline (`visibleTasks`).

No user-visible gap; both capabilities exist in the product. This is cleanup.

**Why it is worth doing rather than ignoring:** these are decoys in exactly the search that found `930da7`. Anyone auditing "is this feature wired up?" has to open each one and work out that it is stale rather than broken. I just spent that time. Deleting them makes the next orphan check trustworthy.

Before deleting, confirm each really is superseded rather than merely unmounted — the inline implementation should cover what the component did. If one turns out to have behavior the inline version lacks, it belongs on its own card instead of in the bin.

Leave `components/ui/accordion.tsx` and `components/ui/badge.tsx` alone. They are unused shadcn primitives from a UI kit, which is normal.

## Done when

Both files are gone, `npm test`, `npm run lint` and `npm run typecheck` still pass, and nothing in the product changed.
